items.rule: Incorporated or sponsored by an organisation that administers the grant
items.quote: Community groups must be incorporated or sponsored (under an auspicing arrangement) by another group or organisation that will administer their grant funding
Community groups with a volunteer base.

items.rule: Project is in waterways or riparian zones feeding the Swan and Canning rivers
items.quote: Must be in waterways or riparian zones located in the Swan Canning Catchment or other catchments of concern (please contact us for more information) that feed into the Swan and Canning rivers

items.rule: Project addresses at least one required restoration objective
items.quote: Must address at least one of the following criteria:

items.rule: One-year project seeking AUD 3,000–10,000, excluding GST
items.quote: In 2027-28 between $3,000 and $10,000 (ex GST) is available for one-year projects.

items.rule: Projects on private land demonstrate a clear public benefit
items.quote: For projects on private land, a clear benefit to the public must be demonstrated.

items.rule: Project has a support letter from each landowner or land manager
items.quote: Require a letter of support for the project from each of the land owner(s)/ manager(s).

items.rule: Funded project has adequate insurance and a signed Job Safety Analysis or equivalent
items.quote: All applicants must have adequate insurance and a signed JSA or equivalent for the project.

items.item: Landowner or land manager support letters, including maintenance commitments
items.quote: A letter of support for the project from the land owner(s) or land manager(s) including maintenance commitments and any covenants on the project site.

items.item: Site map showing location, north arrow and project extent
items.quote: Map(s) of the project site clearly showing the location, North arrow and extent of the project.

items.item: Project timeline using the supplied template
items.quote: Provide your project timeline using the template provided.

items.item: Project budget using the supplied template
items.quote: Attach your budget using the template provided

items.item: Contractor quotations with Australian Business Numbers, if contractors are used
items.quote: Paid contractors undertaking works must provide an ABN and quotation for works proposed.

items.item: Evidence supporting budget estimates, if applicable
items.quote: Supporting evidence to justify budget estimates (if applicable).

items.item: Sponsor details and agreement to administer the grant, if applicable
items.quote: Applicants with a sponsor (auspicor) will need to provide the sponsoring organisation’s details and evidence of their agreement to receive and administer the grant funding.

items.item: ATO Statement by a supplier, if incorporated without an ABN and receiving funds directly
items.quote: Incorporated groups without an ABN may still be eligible to receive the funding directly. An Australian Taxation Office (ATO) Statement by a supplier form will need to be completed and provided to DBCA with the application.

steps.quote: APPLICATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED BY 4:00pm, Friday 11 December 2026.

steps.step: Additional or outstanding supporting information, if needed
steps.quote: Any additional or supporting information due* 22 January 2027
All applications will be assessed by a panel consisting of representatives with relevant expertise including foreshore restoration, fauna habitat and water quality.

steps.step: Project development and grant agreement negotiations
steps.quote: Negotiations and project development will be required between the applicant and DBCA before finalisation of the project agreement.

items.quote: A completed report is to be submitted by the grant recipient at the end of each financial year of the project

answer.notes: Round 10 covers projects from 1 July 2027 to 30 June 2028; applications close at 4pm AWST on 11 December 2026. Required restoration objectives concern waterway habitat, foreshore revegetation and weed control, natural regeneration, bank stabilisation or water quality. Financial or in-kind contributions are a priority, not a stated mandatory match. Landowner and sponsor support letters are recommended with the initial application but may be supplied by 22 January 2027. Insurance evidence is required before funds are released. Reporting is stated as annual, with Round 10 reports due in July 2028. Chemical weed-control training may be required, so it is not recorded as a mandatory duty. The guidelines require compliance with a separate project agreement that was not publicly linked. Older Round 9 rules were not used.
